headline: No UAC side beats Abilene Christian
dek: Abilene Christian lost three matches this season, all to opponents from outside the conference, the latest in its final match. Across the season it scored 36 goals and conceded fifteen.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Little Rock, Austin Peay and West Georgia scored least and finish at the foot of the table in that same order; scoring and standing part company only higher up.

wire.line: West Georgia ends the season without a win, with seven goals scored in all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches from the opening days of August passed their dates with no published result, all involving North Alabama or West Georgia.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bella Medrano made 120 saves for Abilene Christian at a .889 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jessica Baires has eleven assists and ten goals for Tarleton State, from midfield.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tarleton State drew ten times this season, more often than it won.

last_match.line: Abilene Christian had not lost since early September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
